name: What should I ask before hiring a kitchen remodel contractor?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a kitchen remodeling contractor before I hire them?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a kitchen remodeling contractor before I hire them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a kitchen remodel contractor, ask questions that reveal how they manage scope, communication, and surprises. Find out how many similar projects they have completed, who will be on site, and who handles permits and inspections. Ask for a detailed timeline, a payment schedule, and a written explanation of what happens if hidden damage is discovered. Clarify whether demolition, haul-away, fixtures, appliances, and finish allowances are included. It is also important to understand how change orders are priced and approved. A contractor who gives vague answers or avoids specifics may create more risk later. The best contractor is not just skilled at building; they should also be organized enough to manage the project cleanly from planning through final punch list.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar projects, permit handling, timeline, payment schedule, cleanup, subcontractors, change orders, and how hidden issues are handled. You should also confirm whether the bid includes demolition, haul-away, fixtures, and allowances for materials.
